# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta11

## Prepared static/layout backend adoption

This prerelease is the first frontend phase of the Prepared Render Model
migration introduced by NaviMower 0.4.5-beta21 and stabilized in beta23/beta24.

### Single mower

- Discover the integration-owned prepared render manifest from the normal Map API
  response.
- Fetch the content-addressed static JSON resource only when its identity changes.
- Reuse prepared zone / Off-limit / VF-off / Channel / Gate Area SVG `path_d`
  values instead of rebuilding those paths from raw point arrays in the browser.
- Use the backend's card-equivalent 1000x1000 layout matrix, including the
  existing 5% padding and optional Gate Area bounds.
- Use prepared centroids / bounds / area metadata for label anchoring and layout.
- Preserve raw zone boundary flags for the existing solid/dashed perimeter
  presentation until that metadata is part of the prepared contract.
- Preserve all card-owned styling, labels, interaction, zoom/pan, mower artwork
  and underlays.

### Multi mower

- Load one prepared static resource per member through the integration-owned
  manifest advertised in Site/frontend metadata.
- Render prepared local `path_d` geometry inside the existing member
  transformation, so the Site API remains the authority for cross-map alignment.
- Share identical already-fetched prepared resource bodies through the card's
  content-addressed browser cache.
- Keep raw member geometry as a complete fallback.

### Compatibility and safety

Prepared rendering is strictly opt-in:

- older integrations without `prepared_render_model` continue on the existing
  raw Map API path;
- a missing/building/failed prepared resource leaves the current legacy map
  visible;
- a prepared resource whose `map_revision` does not match the current payload
  is rejected;
- a resource reporting failed geometry parity is rejected;
- current-cycle artifacts, MQTT/live trail, History/session archives, Gate Area
  editing and all mower controls are unchanged in beta11.

### Regression coverage

Add a prepared-static regression covering:

- asynchronous legacy-first -> prepared-static adoption;
- backend matrix application;
- prepared SVG path rendering;
- content-addressed resource reuse across card instances;
- no static resource re-download from progress-only payload churn;
- legacy fallback when discovery is absent;
- stale map-revision rejection.

The existing native-browser zone-artifact/Multi regression continues to cover
the complete legacy fallback path.

## Field-test signal

With NaviMower 0.4.5-beta24, Home Assistant diagnostics should change from zero
prepared reads to:

- `prepared_render_model.manifest_reads > 0`;
- `static_resource_reads > 0`;
- `live_resource_reads = 0` in beta11.

The live-route resource migration is intentionally reserved for the next large
frontend beta.
